exposure: Type of acute leukemia (acute myelogenous leukemia [AML] and acute lymphoblastic leukemia [ALL])
cohort: 5 pregnant women diagnosed with acute leukemia at a tertiary-care hospital in Nagano, Japan, over a 20-year period
finding: Pregnancy-associated acute leukemia can be treated similarly to non-pregnant patients, with some patients able to deliver healthy babies, although pregnancy presents unique challenges requiring multidisciplinary care.
gest_age: First, second, or third trimester at diagnosis
